mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT inv.invoice_id) FROM invoices inv JOIN invoice_details invd ON invd.invoice_id = inv.invoice_id JOIN drink_details dd ON dd.drink_detail_id = invd.drink_detail_id JOIN drinks d ON d.drink_id = dd.drink_id WHERE d.drink_category_id = #{categoryId} AND inv.status = 0 AND inv.is_deleted = FALSE AND inv.deleted_at IS NULL AND invd.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.is_deleted = FALSE AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND dd.deleted_at IS NULL
